nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space and let $F \colon E \to \mathbb{R}$ be additive, that is, $F(x + y) = F(x) + F(y)$ for all $x, y \in E$. If for every continuous map $x \colon [0, 1] \to E$ the function $t \mapsto F(x(t))$ on $[0, 1]$ is Borel measurable, then $F$ is continuous.
nodes.title: Mazur's Problem 24: additive functionals measurable along curves are continuous

nodes.summary: There is a continuous linear functional $L$ on the real Banach space $\ell^\infty$ of bounded real sequences with the supremum norm such that $L(f) \ge 0$ whenever $f_n \ge 0$ for every $n$, $L$ maps the constant sequence $1$ to $1$, $L(f) = L(g)$ whenever $g_n = f_{n+1}$ for every $n$, and $L(f) = l$ whenever the sequence $f_n$ converges to $l$.
nodes.title: Existence of Banach limits

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a set and give the space $\mathbb{R}^H$ of all real-valued functions on $H$ the topology of pointwise convergence. Then for every continuous linear functional $f \colon \mathbb{R}^H \to \mathbb{R}$ there are a natural number $n$, points $t_1, \dots, t_n \in H$ and real numbers $\alpha_1, \dots, \alpha_n$ such that $f(x) = \sum_{i=1}^n \alpha_i \, x(t_i)$ for every $x \in \mathbb{R}^H$.
nodes.title: Continuous linear functionals on the space of all real functions

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a finite measure on a measurable space $\alpha$ and let $(f_i)_{i \in \iota}$ be a family of integrable real functions on $\alpha$. The family is uniformly integrable, meaning that it is bounded in $L^1(\mu)$ and that for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is $\delta > 0$ with $\int_s |f_i| \, d\mu \le \varepsilon$ for every $i$ and every measurable set $s$ with $\mu(s) \le \delta$, if and only if the…
nodes.title: Dunford–Pettis weak compactness criterion

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a Banach space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. A subset of $E$ is compact in the weak topology if and only if it is sequentially compact in the weak topology, that is, every sequence in it has a subsequence that converges weakly to a point of the subset.
nodes.title: Eberlein–Šmulian theorem

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a reflexive complex Banach space, that is, the canonical embedding of $X$ into its double dual is surjective, and let $C \subseteq X$ be a nonempty closed convex set. Then for every $x_0 \in X$ there is $y_0 \in C$ such that $\|x_0 - y_0\| = \inf_{y \in C} \|x_0 - y\|$.
nodes.title: Nearest points in reflexive Banach spaces

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $E^{**}$ be its bidual and let $J : E \to E^{**}$ be the canonical embedding. In the weak-star topology of $E^{**}$, the closure of the image under $J$ of the closed unit ball of $E$ is exactly the closed unit ball of $E^{**}$.
nodes.title: Goldstine's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an infinite-dimensional Banach space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. Then there is a sequence $(\varphi_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of continuous linear functionals on $E$ with $\|\varphi_n\| = 1$ for every $n$ such that $\varphi_n(x) \to 0$ for every $x \in E$; that is, the unit sphere of the dual of $E$ contains a weak-star null sequence.
nodes.title: Josefson–Nissenzweig theorem

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a Banach space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $C$ be a subset of its dual $E^*$ that is convex over $\mathbb{R}$. Then $C$ is weak-star closed if and only if, for every $r > 0$, the set $\{\varphi \in C : \|\varphi\| \le r\}$ is weak-star closed.
nodes.title: Krein–Smulian theorem

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a Banach space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, with dual $E^*$, bidual $E^{**}$ and canonical embedding $J \colon E \to E^{**}$. Let $M$ and $N$ be finite-dimensional normed spaces over $\mathbb{K}$ with injective bounded linear maps $i_M \colon M \to E^{**}$ and $i_N \colon N \to E^*$, and let $\varepsilon > 0$. nodes.title: Principle of local reflexivity

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
